fix_commit_message:
[rab/gsab] Fix byte length computation for length-tracking TAs

This bug went unnoticed so long, since we only used byte length in
computations where it was divided by element size.

Now, after the length field was removed, byte length is the ground
truth.

Fixed: 421228429

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix ea0fdeca9749 on top of intro de42e588f4f7 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: During the refactoring that introduced `GetVariableByteLengthOrOutOfBounds`, the old code naturally aligned the result by dividing by element size before returning (returning a count of elements). The new function returns byte length directly, but the author forgot to add the corresponding `RoundDown` to ensure the byte length is a valid multiple of the element size. The bug was latent because all prior callers divided the byte length by element size immediately after (so any partial byte at the end was silently truncated), but once byte length became the primary source of truth the misalignment became observable.
